wp-on-device-ai-assistant.name: WP On-Device AI Assistant
wp-on-device-ai-assistant.summary: WordPress plugin providing an on-device AI assistant: AI Assistant Block, Paragraph Rewriter, Title Generator.

event.title: Devpost Software Showcase — Staff Picks & Rails

inspiration_intel.the_wedge: They built the thing that survives the no-budget, no-internet, no-permission case.
inspiration_intel.what_it_does: WordPress plugin providing an on-device AI assistant: AI Assistant Block, Paragraph Rewriter, Title Generator.
steal_this: Put the model on the device and make connectivity a quality setting. It reads as a privacy feature and buys reliability for free.
Ship as a plugin/widget/block inside the incumbent UI. Adoption is one checkbox, not a migration project.
inspiration_intel.naive_version_vs_this: A prompt box that asks a human to describe what they want. — then WP On-Device AI Assistant made the step measurable, gated, or priced instead.
inspiration_intel.reuse_surface: portable to any agent that touches production data

steal_this: Steal the framing: Code Repair & Patching work inside Developer Tooling & Code Intelligence, done as a bounded loop.
inspiration_intel.naive_version_vs_this: A form with 14 fields nobody fills in. — then ZeroDay AI made the step measurable, gated, or priced instead.

brainbar.name: BrainBar
brainbar.summary: Five AI agents live inside Grafana: querying Mimir, Loki, and Tempo, writing incidents and annotations, catching a broken take before the reshoot.

inspiration_intel.the_wedge: They assumed the expensive step (generation, review, data entry) should be priced before it runs.
inspiration_intel.what_it_does: Five AI agents live inside Grafana: querying Mimir, Loki, and Tempo, writing incidents and annotations, catching a broken take before the reshoot.
steal_this: Invert the pipeline: generate last, verify first. Ship the checker as the artifact and the content as its output.
Take the constraint you were going to write a workaround for, and make it the headline. Broken-and-proud beats blocked-and-polished.
